topics.title: Ellen DeGeneres Ex-Boyfriend Interview
topics.summary: A man claiming to be Ellen DeGeneres' high school boyfriend discusses their brief relationship, describing it as lasting about a month and a half with four sexual encounters. He recounts details about her appearance and sexual responsiveness, and discusses learning about her coming out as a lesbian years later.

topics.title: Howard Stern Show Vaginal Sound Performance
topics.summary: Radio host Howard Stern interviews female callers who demonstrate the ability to produce sounds by passing air through their vaginas. Two women perform the technique live on air, including a duet over "Flight of the Bumblebee," while Stern discusses organizing a paid performance event.

topics.title: Radio Show Broadcast with Celebrity Encounters
topics.summary: Radio hosts discuss attending a Ring Sting concert featuring Motown performances and Stevie Wonder, then recount celebrity encounters including meetings with Julia Roberts and Sidney Poitier. The show includes a call from a San Diego radio station manager about moving to a new frequency.

topics.title: Radio Host Flogging Sketch
topics.summary: A radio sketch featuring a guest in slave costume being chained to a tree and struck with a paddle. The host frames the act as commentary on racial double standards, referencing a competitor's event and discussing the guest's suspended license violations.

topics.title: Howard Stern Show Sketch and Interview
topics.summary: A radio show segment featuring a staged flogging sketch with a guest named Adrian, followed by a phone interview with basketball player Dennis Rodman discussing his new book and Oprah Winfrey's decision not to promote it on her show.

topics.title: Dennis Rodman Interview and Press Conference
topics.summary: Radio host interviews NBA player Dennis Rodman about his autobiography, basketball career, and personal life, followed by a comedic press conference segment addressing new radio markets in Fayetteville and Minneapolis.
